[[Samovar]]s | founded = {{Start date and age|1946}} | dissolved = | ground = [[Arsenal Stadium (Tula)|Arsenal Stadium]] | capacity = 19,241{{cite web |title=стадион Центральный стадион "Арсенал" |url=https://premierliga.ru/stadiums/stadiums_103.html |website=premierliga.ru |access-date=16 December 2018}} | owner = Valery Grinkovsky | chairman = Alexander Zotov | manager = Vacant | league = [[Russian First League]] | season = [[2025–26 Russian First League|2025–26]] | position = 13th of 18 | current = | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = | body1 = | rightarm1 = | shorts1 = | socks1 = | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = | body2 = | rightarm2 = | shorts2 = | socks2 = | website = {{official URL}} }} '''FC Arsenal Tula''' ({{langx|ru|ФК Арсенал Тула}}) is a Russian professional [[association football|football]] club from [[Tula, Russia|Tula]] playing in the second-tier [[Russian First League]]. Originally founded in 1923, FC Arsenal Tula was promoted to the [[Russian Premier League]] in 2014 for the first time in its history after finishing as runners-up in the [[2013–14 Russian National Football League]]. This achievement marked three successive promotions for the club. On its debut season in the [[2014–15 Russian Premier League]], it finished in last place and was relegated back to the FNL. The club spent one season in the FNL before returning to the Premier League for the 2016–17 season, in which they have competed until the [[2021–22 Russian Premier League]] season, when they were relegated again after finishing last.{{cite web|publisher=[[Russian Football National League]]|url=http://1fnl.ru/news/5011|script-title=ru: «Арсенал» возвращается в Премьер-лигу!|date=10 May 2016|language=ru}}{{cite web|publisher=Russian Premier League|url=https://premierliga.ru/news/rfpl/news_28054.html|title="Уфа" вырвала победу у "Арсенала", туляки досрочно заняли 16-е место|date=14 May 2022|language=ru}} The team currently plays its home games in [[Arsenal Stadium (Tula)|Arsenal Stadium]], which has a capacity of 19,241."}}
